description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open source testing management tool. It handles navigation, frame loading, and test plan validation, including user authentication, dynamic URL generation, and execution of test-related actions.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine instance used for rendering views.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: Class managing test plan data and operations.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Class managing test project data and session context.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: Class for managing hierarchical test item structures.

methods.name: checkTestPlan
methods.description: Verifies user rights for a specific test plan.

methods.name: build_link_exec
methods.description: Constructs URL parameters for execution links.

methods.name: process_exec
methods.description: Prepares and returns URL for executing test case results.

methods.name: process_xta2m
methods.description: Prepares URL for tasks assigned to the current user.

methods.name: check_exec
methods.description: Validates or retrieves data needed for execution actions.

methods.name: check_xta2m
methods.description: Checks if the user has rights for assigned tasks.

methods.name: launch_inner_exec
methods.description: Handles inner frame logic for test execution navigation.

methods.name: launch_inner_xta2m
methods.description: Handles inner frame logic for tasks assigned to user.

methods.name: launch_outer_exec
methods.description: Sets up outer frame for test execution interface.

methods.name: launch_outer_xta2m
methods.description: Sets up outer frame for assigned tasks interface.

methods.name: buildCookie
methods.description: Creates cookie info for test item navigation.
